messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Higher and further education in North Rhine-Westphalia during the 1980s?
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: GENESIS NRW Hochschulstatistik Studierende 1980 1989 historische daten
Nordrhein Westfalen statistisches Jahrbuch 1985 Hochschulen Studenten berufliche Schulen Daten
GESIS HISTAT Nordrhein Westfalen Hochschulen Studierende 1980 Zeitreihe
action.query: GENESIS NRW Hochschulstatistik Studierende 1980 1989 historische daten

content.text: {"items":[{"title":"Studierende an Düsseldorfer Hochschulen seit 1970 – Open Government Data","url_or_doi":"https://data.gov.de/suche/daten/studierende-an-dusseldorfer-hochschulen-seit-1970","justification":"Highly relevant historical dataset covering university and higher education enrollment in Düsseldorf, North Rhine-Westphalia, from 1970 onward, including the entire 1980s. Contains student enrollment figures by institution and gender. Particularly useful for analyzing changes in higher education participation during the 1980s."},{"title":"Studenten an den Hochschulen in Nordrhein-Westfalen, Wintersemester 1987/88 – Landesamt für Datenverarbeitung und Statistik","url_or_doi":"https://www.statistischebibliothek.de/mir/servlets/MCRFileNodeServlet/NWHeft_derivate_00020163/Beitrag%20624_A.pdf","justification":"Official historical statistical publication containing higher education enrollment data for North Rhine-Westphalia. Includes annual student enrollment figures from winter semester 1972/73 through 1987/88, covering most of the 1980s. Provides enrollment totals and annual growth rates, making it particularly useful for longitudinal analysis of higher education expansion."},{"title":"Studenten an den Hochschulen in Nordrhein-Westfalen, 1982/83–1985/86 – Landtag Nordrhein-Westfalen","url_or_doi":"https://www.landtag.nrw.de/portal/WWW/dokumentenarchiv/Dokument/MMV10-589.pdf","justification":"Official parliamentary statistical document providing university-level enrollment figures for North Rhine-Westphalia during the academic years 1982/83 through 1985/86. Includes individual institutions such as RWTH Aachen and the universities of Bielefeld, Bochum, Bonn, Dortmund, Düsseldorf, Cologne, and Münster. Suitable for comparing institutional enrollment trends across the region during the 1980s."},{"title":"Wirtschaft und Statistik 2/1990 – Berufliche Schulen 1980/81–1988/89","url_or_doi":"https://www.statistischebibliothek.de/mir/servlets/MCRFileNodeServlet/DEAusgabe_derivate_00000396/Wirtschaft_und_Statistik-1990-02.pdf","justification":"Official German statistical publication containing historical data on vocational and further education during the 1980s. Includes North Rhine-Westphalia and covers academic years 1980/81 through 1988/89. Provides statistics on vocational schools, technical colleges, specialized schools, and students, including gender and foreign nationality breakdowns. Particularly relevant for researching further education and vocational training."},{"title":"Universities in the Federal Republic of Germany, 1949–2001 – B2FIND / HISTAT","url_or_doi":"https://b2find.eudat.eu/dataset/05049f00-e0f3-562d-875a-854edbada15f","justification":"Historical higher education dataset spanning 1949–2001, including the entire 1980s. Contains longitudinal statistical information on German universities, university types, and student enrollment. Relevant for examining higher education developments in North Rhine-Westphalia within the broader West German context. The availability of North Rhine-Westphalia-specific breakdowns should be checked in the underlying tables."},{"title":"HISTAT – Historical Statistics of Germany","url_or_doi":"https://histat.safe-frankfurt.de/","justification":"Historical statistical database containing long-term German socioeconomic and educational time series. Includes historical education and university statistics suitable for investigating developments during the 1980s. Potentially useful for identifying datasets concerning higher education institutions, enrollment, educational participation, and vocational education in North Rhine-Westphalia. Geographic coverage varies by dataset."},{"title":"Statistisches Jahrbuch Nordrhein-Westfalen 2003 – Bildung und Kultur","url_or_doi":"https://webshop.it.nrw.de/gratis/Z026%20200300.pdf","justification":"Official statistical yearbook from North Rhine-Westphalia containing retrospective educational statistics. Its higher education section includes student enrollment data beginning with winter semester 1989/90, broken down by institution type, gender, and nationality. Useful for examining the end of the 1980s and comparing higher education developments with subsequent years."},{"title":"Hochschulstatistik Nordrhein-Westfalen – Historical Higher Education Statistics","url_or_doi":"https://www.destatis.de/GPStatistik/servlets/MCRFileNodeServlet/NWHeft_derivate_00002844/B302200400_A.pdf","justification":"Official historical higher education statistical publication from North Rhine-Westphalia's statistical authority. Contains retrospective information on higher education institutions, including historical university enrollment and institutional developments. Its historical coverage extends to periods relevant to the 1980s, although individual tables must be checked for their precise starting years."},{"title":"Studierendenzahlen in Nordrhein-Westfalen – Internet-Portal Westfälische Geschichte","url_or_doi":"https://www.lwl.org/westfaelische-geschichte/portal/Internet/input_felder/langDatensatz_ebene4.php?urlID=495&url_tabelle=tab_websegmente","justification":"Historical educational statistics resource documenting university enrollment developments in North Rhine-Westphalia. Includes historical student figures for the 1980s, including the academic year 1985/86. Draws on official statistical publications and is useful for analyzing long-term trends in university enrollment and higher education participation."},{"title":"Statistisches Jahrbuch Nordrhein-Westfalen 1980 – Historical Education Statistics","url_or_doi":"https://recht.nrw.de/system/files/MBL_Archiv/9493-xmmmbl819.pdf","justification":"Official North Rhine-Westphalia government publication documenting the availability of the 1980 statistical yearbook and contemporary education statistics. It identifies historical statistical publications covering university students, vocational schools, and vocational training around 1979–1980. Useful as a bibliographic entry point for locating original education datasets from the beginning of the 1980s. The linked document is a publication listing rather than the statistical yearbook itself."}]}
